gaps: The window and summary are in the analysis CRS translated by its origin (D1); the canonical scene's buildings are in ENU about the area anchor. In window mode the map draws only window features, so they agree with each other, but an explored building's canonical record and window footprints may differ by the grid convergence between the two frames.
Selecting a footprint in an area whose context read refused shows only its identifier and kind; the building's register, ledger and canonical record are not opened from window mode.
The camera is centred on the extent (engine.panTo); fitting the whole extent needs a scene engine method outside this task's paths.
The summary's featureCount counts every kind; the line says 'buildings' when every drawn feature is a building and 'features' otherwise.
